scriptLines: query: 'SELECT a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,p.paciente_key,dep.departamento_key,dx.diagnostico_key,fi.fecha_key AS fecha_ingreso_key,fa.fecha_key AS fecha_alta_key,a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,DATEDIFF(day,a.admission_date,a.discharge_date) AS dias_estancia,1 AS conteo_admisiones FROM silver.admissions a OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) icd_code,severity FROM silver.diagnoses WHERE admission_id=a.admission_id ORDER BY diagnosis_id) d JOIN gold.dim_paciente p ON p.patient_id_bk=a.patient_id JOIN gold.dim_departamento dep ON dep.nombre_departamento=a.department JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico dx ON dx.codigo_icd=COALESCE(d.icd_code,\'SIN_DIAG\') AND dx.nivel_severidad=COALESCE(NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM(d.severity)),\'\'),\'No informado\') JOIN gold.dim_fecha fi ON fi.fecha_key=CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),a.admission_date,112)) LEFT JOIN gold.dim_fecha fa ON fa.fecha_key=CONVERT(int,CONVERT(char(8),a.discharge_date,112)) WHERE (a.discharge_date IS NULL OR fa.fecha_key IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.fact_admisiones g WHERE g.admission_id_bk=a.admission_id)',
